datasets.name: krdt
datasets.sql:
select cu.name ,pri.name,p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,p.creditlineamount,h.rest,p.annualyinterestrate||'%',r.percent||'%',h.duerest,h.pledgeprice from
customers cu,prinad pri,
CM_active_credits p,
CM_history h,
CM_RESERVE_TYPES r
where
p.boorowerid=cu.id and cu.prinad_kod=pri.id and
p.id=h.creditid   and
h.hdate=:dd  and
h.reserveid=r.id
order by pri.name

datasets.name: emdt
datasets.sql:
SELECT distinct
 a1.bal_cn1 dbal_cn ,a1.acc_no
,a2.bal_cn1 kbal_cn,a2.acc_no
,pr.dat ,pr.ID
,pr.NAME, SB_EXPERTANALYSE.GetUserName(pr.op_id) as UserName
,sb_memorial.getcurrencyshortname(pr.val_acc) val_acc, pr.val_acc as DCurrency
,sb_memorial.getcurrencyshortname(pr.currencyid_c) currencyid_c, pr.currencyid_c as KCurrency
,pr.ammount
,pr.ammount_c
,pr.lammount
,pr.op_id as Operator, sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(pr.vid_op, pr.val_acc, pr.currencyID_c) as OperationType
,a1.acc_no debitor, a1.filial as DebetFilial
,a1.NAME dname
,a2.acc_no kreditor, a2.filial as CreditFilial
,a2.NAME kname
,pr.debt
,pr.kredit
,con.CNTR_NAME
,pri.name
FROM  provarch pr, Account A1, Account A2, customers cu,Prinad pri
/*,(select * from Account where kli_id in(select id from Customers where prinad_kod<>0)) A1
,(select * from Account where kli_id in(select id from Customers where prinad_kod<>0)) A2*/
     ,countries con
    WHERE
       (pr.debt=a1.ID)AND(pr.kredit=a2.ID)
       AND(pr.Dat between :d1 and :d2) and (nvl(pr.COUNTRID,0)=con.id)
and A1.kli_id=cu.id
and A2.kli_id=cu.id
and Cu.prinad_kod=pri.id
and cu.prinad_kod <>0
ORDER BY  pri.name,pr.dat

datasets.name: qal
datasets.sql:
select
  RestForLastPeriod.AccountID ,RestForLastPeriod.name_1 as name_1,
  RestForLastPeriod.AccNo , RestForLastPeriod.AccName as ACC_NAME ,
  RestForLastPeriod.CurrencyID ,
  RestForLastPeriod.BranchID ,
  RestForLastPeriod.BalanceNo ,
  RestForFirstPeriod.Active as BeginActive ,
  RestForFirstPeriod.Passive as BeginPassive ,
  RestForFirstPeriod.LActive as LBeginActive ,
  RestForFirstPeriod.LPassive as LBeginPassive ,
  TurnOvers.DTurnOver ,
  TurnOvers.CTurnOver ,
  TurnOvers.LDTurnOver ,
  TurnOvers.LCTurnOver ,
  RestForLastPeriod.Active as EndActive ,
  RestForLastPeriod.Passive as EndPassive ,
  RestForLastPeriod.LActive as LEndActive ,
  RestForLastPeriod.LPassive as LEndPassive
from

(select
  ac.ID as AccountID ,
  ac.acc_no as AccNo ,
  b.bal_cn  as BalanceNo ,

  sb_mtoutview.active (
    ar.ostat,
    b.typeid,
    b.additionaltypeid
  ) as Active ,

  sb_mtoutview.passiv (
     ar.ostat,
     b.typeid,
     b.additionaltypeid
  ) as Passive ,

  sb_mtoutview.active (
    ar.pok_ostat,
    b.typeid,
    b.additionaltypeid
  ) as LActive ,

  sb_mtoutview.passiv (
     ar.pok_ostat,
     b.typeid,
     b.additionaltypeid
  ) as LPassive

from
  account ac ,
  archost ar ,
  bal_spr1  b  /*52*/
where
  ar.acc_id = ac.id and
  ac.bal_cn1 = b.bal_cn and     /*55*/
  ar.DatDate = :BeginPeriod  and
  ((ac.Close_Dat is null)or(ac.Close_Dat > :BeginPeriod))
) RestForFirstPeriod ,

(select
  ac.ID as AccountID , sb_mtoutview.prinadof(ac.id) as name_1,
  ac.acc_no as AccNo , ac.name as AccName ,
  ac.val_acc as CurrencyID ,
  ac.filial as BranchID ,
  b.bal_cn  as BalanceNo ,

  sb_mtoutview.active (
    ar.ostat,
    b.typeid,
    b.additionaltypeid
  ) as Active ,

  sb_mtoutview.passiv (
     ar.ostat,
     b.typeid,
     b.additionaltypeid
  ) as Passive ,

  sb_mtoutview.active (
    ar.pok_ostat,
    b.typeid,
    b.additionaltypeid
  ) as LActive ,

  sb_mtoutview.passiv (
     ar.pok_ostat,
     b.typeid,
     b.additionaltypeid
  ) as LPassive

from
  account ac ,
  archost ar ,
  bal_spr1   b  /*94*/
where
  ar.acc_id = ac.id and
  ac.bal_cn1 = b.bal_cn  and  /*97*/
  ar.DatDate = :EndDate  and
 ((ac.Close_Dat is null)or(ac.Close_Dat > :BeginPeriod))
) RestForLastPeriod ,

(select
  ac.ID as AccountID ,
  min(ac.acc_no) as AccNo,
  min(b.bal_cn)  as BalanceNo ,
  sum(ar.Obr_D) as DTurnOver ,
  sum(ar.Obr_K) as CTurnOver ,
  sum(ar.Pok_Obr_D) as LDTurnOver ,
  sum(ar.Pok_Obr_K) as LCTurnOver

from
  account ac ,
  archost ar ,
  bal_spr1   b  /*114*/
where
  ar.acc_id = ac.id and
  ac.bal_cn1 = b.bal_cn  and /*117*/
  ar.DatDate between :BeginDate and :EndDate
group by
  ac.ID
) TurnOvers

where
   RestForLastPeriod.AccountID = RestForFirstPeriod.AccountID  (+) and
   RestForLastPeriod.AccountID = TurnOvers.AccountID

order by
  RestForLastPeriod.name_1,RestForLastPeriod.AccName

datasets.name: PeriodPrefixData
datasets.sql:
select 
  MAX(DAT) as PeriodPrefix
from 
  Operkurs
where 
  DAT<:ADATE
